description: This PHP class implements the DSUM function for a spreadsheet calculation library, adding numbers in a database column that meet specified criteria.

classes.name: DSum
classes.description: Represents the implementation of the DSUM function, which sums cells in a database column based on criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the sum of a database column that matches the specified criteria, returning null or an error if the field is invalid.
